hook: Andrew Garfield plays *Sam Altman* in the new trailer for the movie about his firing at OpenAI
caption:
NEON released the official trailer for Artificial, Luca Guadagnino's movie about the days in 2023 when OpenAI fired Sam Altman and then brought him back.
Andrew Garfield plays Altman, Ike Barinholtz plays Elon Musk, Yura Borisov plays Ilya Sutskever and Monica Barbaro plays Mira Murati.
It opens in select US theaters on Christmas Day, after Amazon MGM dropped the film earlier this year.
